image_description: A close-up image of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with eight overlapping calcareous plates visible on its dorsal surface. The plates show textured growth lines and mottled coloration in shades of brown, green, and grey. The plates are embedded in a leathery girdle that appears slightly spiny or textured around the edges. The chiton is dorsoventrally flattened against the rock surface.
